title: backlog.py warns of a near-duplicate at new and of a recurring process item left out of a sprint
goal: backlog.py similar TITLE ranks open items by word overlap of title and goal, new warns naming them above a threshold, items carry an optional recurs list of sprint ids, and start warns when an open P1 process item with two or more recurrences is not in the sprint; test_backlog plants a duplicate and a recurring item
